name: norvidwave
title: norvidwave
blurb: a five-track, ~10-minute EP about @norvid-studies.bsky.social — charts, graphs, and the eternal grind of posting, set to music. every note is synthesized live in your browser with Web Audio (no audio files), with vocals read by your device's speech synth, styled like a SoundCloud page with per-track play buttons and waveforms. @cee.wtf asked for this one.
